headline: Premier League live updates: Arsenal eke by Nottingham Forest
description: Arsenal got an important win as they look to keep pace with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League. Follow live with ESPN's dedicated match blog.

headline: Fabian Hürzeler tells Brighton fans: Have a beer and don't look at Premier League table
description: Fabian Hürzeler has told Brighton & Hove Albion fans to "enjoy a beer" and not look at the Premier League table to celebrate their win over Crystal Palace.

headline: Jordan Henderson not giving up on England after Chelsea revitalisation
description: Jordan Henderson has not given up on extending his England career after insisting he will use a new lease of life at Chelsea to prove he can still perform at the highest level.

headline: Seven games, seven points: Man United are sleepwalking to another lost season
description: Manchester United were already suffering from their worst start to a Premier League season since 1986. A 1-1 draw with Leeds won't help.

headline: Michael Carrick on Man United's worst start since 1986: Situation 'doesn't look great'
description: Michael Carrick said Manchester United's situation "doesn't look great" after a 1-1 draw at Leeds left the club in the bottom half of the Premier League.
